title: Contractor claims the complete fire-door register has been delivered

correspondence.subject: VBM-803 fire-door register delivery
correspondence.body: The complete fire-door register for VBM-803 has now been delivered to the facilities desk, including every door tag and inspection signature. Nothing remains outstanding on our register submission. Please confirm receipt when you have had a chance to check it. Thanks, Tomas

requirements.name: Complete fire-door register
requirements.description: Submit the register covering every fire-door tag and inspection signature.
